    img = cv2.imread(card_path)

    # Convert to RGB for better color analysis
    img_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
    
    # Get the center of the card where the main suit symbol is displayed
    center_y = h // 2
    center_x = w // 2
    
    # Extract center region (where the main suit symbol is)
    center_region = img_rgb[center_y-120:center_y+120, center_x-120:center_x+120]
    
    # Save center region for inspection
    cv2.imwrite(f'/workdir/center_{card_file}', cv2.cvtColor(center_region, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR))

    center_hsv = cv2.cvtColor(center_region, cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV)
    
    # Calculate average hue in center region
    avg_hue = np.mean(center_hsv[:, :, 0])
    avg_sat = np.mean(center_hsv[:, :, 1])
    avg_val = np.mean(center_hsv[:, :, 2])

    if (0 <= avg_hue <= 15) or (165 <= avg_hue <= 180):
        color = "red"
        print(f"Detected color: RED (hearts or diamonds)")
    elif 90 <= avg_hue <= 130:
        color = "black"
        print(f"Detected color: BLACK (clubs or spades)")
    else:
        print(f"Uncertain color, hue={avg_hue}")
        color = "unknown"
    
    # Try to detect the suit symbol using OCR on the center region
    # Convert to grayscale
    center_gray = cv2.cvtColor(center_region, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
    
    # Apply adaptive threshold
    center_thresh = cv2.adaptiveThreshold(center_gray, 255, cv2.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C, 
                                          cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV, 11, 2)
    
    # Resize for better OCR
    center_resized = cv2.resize(center_thresh, None, fx=2, fy=2, interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
    
    # Convert to PIL Image for OCR
    pil_img = Image.fromarray(center_resized)
    
    # Configure OCR to look for suit symbols
    config = '--psm 10 -c tessedit_char_whitelist=♥♦♣♠'
    
    try:
        text = pytesseract.image_to_string(pil_img, config=config)
        text = text.strip()

            print(f"Center suit OCR result: '{text}'")

    cv2.imwrite(f'/workdir/edges_{card_file}', center_edges)
    
    # Count contours in the suit area

    top_left_resized = cv2.resize(top_left_thresh, None, fx=2, fy=2, interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)
    top_left_pil = Image.fromarray(top_left_resized)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Top-left OCR Error: {e}")
